art_direction: RoomScale category: settlement_structure. A believable miniature living-architecture nursery centered on an asymmetrical branching trunk and a distinctive mature canopy. At the 64-inch Room A settlement camera, the nursery should read as a cultivated tree-workshop rather than a green roof or generic shelter. Keep an open, usable ground-level work area, visible root supports and several large seed pods. Build the foliage from curved, tapered, visibly thick individual leaves; avoid flat cards and sphere crowns. Use deep natural greens, warm living wood and restrained seed-ochre or bloom accents. Preserve the existing 26 x 10 x 18 inch presentation site and all simulation-owned growth and work behavior.
